text_block_list.text: One day, while shopping at the mall—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Aah! What do I do now~~?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was wondering what to give in return 
for the care package they sent me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Right! If you don't mind, could I ask for 
your advice on something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
And about the people I want to give back 
to... It's not just one person, there are 
so many of them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's tastes are so different, I 
haven't found anything that makes me 
think, "This is it!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hrmm. We gather at my folks' place pretty 
often, so something everyone can share 
would probably be best.
choice_data_list: People really look up to you.
People really look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone looks up to my dad, and 
they've all been doting on me too!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone cheers me on, and along with 
snacks, they even give me letters saying 
"Do your best!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That letter made me so incredibly 
happy...! Reading it made my chest burn 
with this huge, roaring fire...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I received so much strength from everyone, 
so I want to give back in the way that'll 
make them happiest of all!!
choice_data_list: Don't you already have your answer?

Haven't you already figured out the 
answer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Um, what would make everyone happy is... 
Ah.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll win tons of different races! 
That's the best way to return the favor, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I've decided! Instead of buying a gift to 
repay you, I'm going to buy gear to help 
me win my races!!
choice_data_list:
High-quality shoes might be the best 
choice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Good tools really are important, 
aren't they!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll lace these up and train 
like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, got it...! Studying is super 
important if we want to win, right?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll buy the book and read it 
cover to cooover!!
